name: West Leisure Resorts Limited
summary: West Leisure Resorts Ltd. functions primarily as an investment holding enterprise. Its activities encompass the trade of diverse commodities, the provision of human capital solutions, and the strategic allocation of capital into equities, mutual funds, and other financial instruments. The company organizes its operations into two main divisions: Financial and Services. Established on January 18, 2008, its corporate headquarters are located in Mumbai, India.
